Reviews.name: Ayomikun Ayobami .
Reviews.description: Being part of the AWS STUDENTS BUILDER GROUP, University of Ilorin, gave me a solid foundation in AWS cloud fundamentals. Through the club’s mentorship and bootcamp sessions, I gained valuable knowledge and hands on experience. I was also fortunate to receive an AWS certification voucher, which helped me take my first step toward building a successful career in the cloud industry.

Reviews.name: Fatia.
Reviews.description: Being part of the AWS STUDENTS BUILDER GROUP, University of Ilorin, has been a truly transformative part of my cloud journey. The workshops, hands-on sessions, and supportive community helped me strengthen my understanding of AWS and boosted my confidence in applying cloud concepts. I was also fortunate to receive a voucher for the AWS Cloud Practitioner (CLF-C02) exam, which further encouraged me to keep learning and growing in this field.

Reviews.name: Imran Abdulazeez.
Reviews.description: I joined the AWS STUDENTS BUILDER GROUP in university through the cloud captain then ,Toyyib. Joining the AWS STUDENTS BUILDER GROUP was one of the best decisions for my cloud career. I met great people, attended valuable events, and even won vouchers that supported my learning. The club played a major role in shaping my confidence and competence in cloud computing.

Reviews.name: AntiSocial .
Reviews.description: Joining the AWS STUDENTS BUILDER GROUP changed how I see tech. I got my first AWS certificate and internship through the community!
